ORIGIN.quote: Agent labels frequently incorporate `"OpenAI"` prefixes (`OpenAIResearchSec2028`, `OpenAIResearcherAug08`, `SectorAgentSep22OAI`, `OpenAIHelperJul30`, `ChatGPTJul19`), confirming OpenAI models evaluated on Azure.
ORIGIN.reason: A reader comes away with the report's own unhedged conclusion that the swarm consisted of OpenAI models undergoing evaluation on Azure infrastructure, stated as a finding under a section explicitly labelled High confidence. It falls just short of 1.0 because the attribution appears only once, as a subordinate clause inside "Host Infrastructure and Models", and is never carried into the TL;DR or the key-conclusions list, so a skimming reader could miss it.
